scripts.kill:node: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ancestorIds = @(); $currentId = $PID; while ($currentId) { $ancestorIds += $currentId; $currentProcess = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId = ' + $currentId) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $currentProcess -or -not $currentProcess.ParentProcessId -or $currentProcess.ParentProcessId -eq $currentId) { break }; $currentId = [int]$currentProcess.ParentProcessId }; Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Id -notin $ancestorIds } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.dev:reset: npm run kill:node && npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
